root.label: National Taxpayer Advocate reports 2024 ITIN returns and taxes

events.label: National Taxpayer Advocate reports 2024 ITIN returns and taxes

slots.name: ITIN tax returns
slots.sentence: In 2024, the National Taxpayer Advocate found 3.8 million tax returns where a taxpayer used an Individual Tax Identification Number, or ITIN.

slots.name: income taxes paid
slots.sentence: According to IRS data, taxpayers who filed those nearly 4 million returns paid $14.4 billion in income taxes and $6.5 billion in Social Security and Medicare taxes.
